# Rever — full guide for AI agents

Rever converts a website URL into a design brief: a detailed prompt describing the page's layout, sections, components, color palette, typography, spacing and interactions, written so that a code-generation model (Lovable, v0, Bolt, Claude, Cursor, GPT) can rebuild the UI in React + Tailwind.

## When to use it

- The user says "clone / copy / recreate / make something like <URL>".
- The user wants a design spec or style breakdown of an existing site.
- You want a compact description of a page's look instead of loading its whole HTML into context.

When not to use it: extracting text/data from a page, sites behind a login, or when you need the site's exact original source code.

## Endpoint

POST https://www.aypiai.online/api/generate-prompt
Content-Type: application/json

Body:
{"url": "https://stripe.com"}

## Authentication

No accounts. Two ways to pay:
1. Agent payment: pay 1 USDC on Base per call and send the transaction hash in `X-Payment`.
2. Access key: a person buys a pack of generations on https://www.aypiai.online (card, via Stripe) and gets an access key (`cs_live_...`). Send it in `X-Access-Key`. Check what's left with `GET /api/balance` (same header).

## Agent payment flow

Step 1 — request without payment:

curl -X POST https://www.aypiai.online/api/generate-prompt \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"url":"https://stripe.com"}'

Response 402:
{
  "error": "Payment Required",
  "x402Version": 1,
  "accepts": [{
    "scheme": "exact",
    "network": "base",
    "chainId": 8453,
    "asset": "0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913",
    "maxAmountRequired": "1000000",
    "payTo": "0x4b1965f9d407ce9f032e9e2465afe7ff8bfb7f3d",
    "description": "UI-to-prompt blueprint for one URL (1 USDC)"
  }],
  "howToPay": "..."
}

Step 2 — transfer 1 USDC (1000000 units, 6 decimals) on Base mainnet to `payTo`. Wait for 2 confirmations (a few seconds).

Step 3 — retry with the transaction hash:

curl -X POST https://www.aypiai.online/api/generate-prompt \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Payment: 0x<64 hex chars>" \
  -d '{"url":"https://stripe.com"}'

Response 200:
{"prompt": "Build a landing page with ...", "url": "https://stripe.com/"}

Rules:
- One transaction hash = one successful generation. Reusing it returns 402 with reason "already been used".
- If the screenshot or model step fails, the payment is released and the same hash can be retried.
- Only USDC transfers to `payTo` of at least 1 USDC in a successful transaction count.

## Errors

- 400 — missing/invalid URL (must be a public http(s) URL).
- 401 — invalid or unknown access key.
- 402 — payment missing, unconfirmed, insufficient or already used (`reason` explains which), or access key with no generations left.
- 502 — screenshot or model failed. Retry: the payment or generation is released.

## MCP

The `rever-mcp` package exposes one tool, `clone_ui(url, payment_tx?)` (or set `REVER_ACCESS_KEY` to use a pack). See https://github.com/chaoui-ahmed/rever-ui-cloner/tree/main/rever-mcp
